origin: OpenCode 1.18.16 request (a Claude model in the capture; the model is changed to gemini-2.5-pro): a Gemini model signs its tool call; the client is given the signature with the call and sends it back with the call in its next request, which the relay is given as extra_content, as Google's OpenAI-compatible API writes it (the model's thinking is lost without it, and Gemini 3 refuses the request). The relay answers are authored from the documented Chat Completions shapes; the expected files are what the gateway does with them.
